content: सेवा [सेव्-अ] .²1 Service, servitude, dependence; attendance; सेवां लाघवकारिणीं कृतधियः स्थाने श्ववृत्तिं विदुः <ls>Mu. 3. 14</ls>; हीनसेवा न कर्तव्या <ls>H. 3. 11</ls>. .²2 Worship, homage, honouring. .²3 Addiction or devotion to, fondness for. .²4 Use, practice, employment, exercise. .²5 Frequenting, resorting to. .²6 Flattery, coaxing or flattering words; अलं सेवया मध्यस्थतां गृहीत्वा भण <ls>M. 3</ls>.
